description: This Java source file defines the WorkEffortKeywordIndex class responsible for indexing keywords associated with work effort entities in the Apache OFBiz framework. It processes various related data and content to generate searchable keywords for indexing and retrieval purposes.

classes.name: WorkEffortKeywordIndex
classes.description: A utility class for indexing keywords related to work effort entities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Main method to index keywords for a given work effort entity, extracting data from related entities and content sources, and storing the indexed keywords.

methods.name: addWeightedDataResourceString
methods.description: Appends content text from a data resource to the list of strings multiple times based on weight for indexing.

methods.name: addWeightedKeywordSourceString
methods.description: Adds a source string to the list with specified weight, used for keyword boosting during indexing.
